instructions: SECTION 2 · You will hear a guide talking to visitors at a museum.

groups.instructions: Choose the correct letter, A, B or C.
groups.strategy: In Section 2 MCQs, all three options are usually mentioned. Underline the key idea in the question stem and listen for the speaker's FINAL position on it.

questions.prompt: The museum building was first used to
questions.explanation: 'originally a warehouse, built in 1868 to store cotton'.

questions.prompt: Visitors are not allowed to take photographs
questions.explanation: 'Photography is allowed everywhere except in the textile gallery'.
questions.trap: Special exhibitions are mentioned — but in connection with a charge, not photography.

questions.prompt: Money from the audio guides is used for

options.text: translating the guides into more languages.

questions.explanation: 'goes towards the restoration of the building' — restoration = repairing.

questions.prompt: The museum particularly needs volunteers to
questions.explanation: 'what we're most short of … are people to help children with our hands-on activities at weekends'.
questions.trap: A — 'People often assume we need historians, but…'

questions.prompt: Today the museum will close early because
questions.explanation: 'we're setting up for an evening event'.
questions.trap: C — refurbishment is mentioned later, for a room, not the closing time.

groups.instructions: Label the map (see map.md). Write the correct letter, A–H, next to Questions 16–20.
groups.strategy: Locate the entrance and 'you are here' first. Follow the speaker's directions with your pencil: 'on your right', 'opposite', 'in the north-east corner', 'between'.

questions.explanation: 'immediately on your right, in the south-east corner' — entering from the south, right = east.
'directly opposite the café, on the other side of the entrance — the room on your left' = south-west.
'three rooms along the north wall. The one in the middle'.
'on the right, in the north-east corner'.
'on the east side of the main hall, between the café and the discovery room'.
questions.trap: D (west side) is the room closed for refurbishment.
